analysis:
【今日摘要】
今天市場情緒波動，受中國DeepSeek AI影響的AI產業大幅下跌，包括Nvidia下跌16%。然而，JFrog因提高AI驅動雲安全需求而上漲7.4%。伯克希爾哈撒韋大幅增持Alphabet股權，擴大對Delta和房地產投資。美國監管機構(OCC)批准了世界自由信託公司的國家信託銀行牌照，允許特朗普家族背後的公司發行穩定幣。

【結語】
投資者務必保持冷靜，避免恐慌性賣出。人工智慧的發展可能會取代一些工作，但也會創造新的職缺和機會。投資者應該關注公司的基本面和長期發展前景，而不是短期市場波動。同時，投資者也應該注意到市場的風險，包括經濟衰退、政治不穩定等因素。

items.title: Maryland tax court voids digital ad tax, orders refunds to Apple, Google and Peacock TV
items.summary: A Maryland state tax court has struck down the state’s first-in-the-nation tax on digital advertising and ordered state officials to repay the tax money already collected from big tech firms.  The Maryland Tax Court said the tax violates the federal Internet Tax Freedom Act as well as the First Amendment and the commerce and due process clauses of the U.S. Constitution.  Maryland estimated the tax, approved in 2021, could raise about $250 million a year to help pay for a sweeping K-12 education measure.
